annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires that after all settings in a received SETTINGS frame have been processed (i.e., applied or ignored if unsupported), the recipient must immediately send a SETTINGS frame with the ACK flag set. The terms used are clear and there is no missing constraint that would allow materially different implementation behaviours.
